title: Collection of several dozen cipher keys of imperial diplomats (Ziffra particularis cum Sacra Caesarea Majestate and others)
shelfmark: SOA Plzeň, pracoviště Klášter u Nepomuka, Rodinný archiv Windischgrätzů, karton 164, inv. č. 1403, sign. 103
note: Mírka's key collection, formed in the 18th century: nomenklators with homophones, bigrams, 300+ codes, nulls; two keys for Charles VI 1720/22; one for the Kinský-Kounic letters of 1697-99. ARON record 'Říšská dvorní rada - miscellanea'.

title: Key for the correspondence with Vitaliano Borromeo
shelfmark: SOA Plzeň, pracoviště Klášter u Nepomuka, Rodinný archiv Windischgrätzů, karton 219, inv. č. 1445, sign. 145
note: A lone key, no matching letters found (Mírka, Crypto-World 1-2/2013 n. 2).

title: Smaller set of cipher keys of the Clam-Gallas collection
shelfmark: SOA Litoměřice, pobočka Děčín, Historická sbírka Clam-Gallasů, karton 392, inv. č. 1397, sign. XV/20
note: Mírka: a smaller set of keys (Crypto-World 1-2/2013 and 3-4/2013, n. 31); no item record online.

title: Chiffrant / Déchiffrant notebooks (3-digit French nomenklator) of Emil von Üchtritz
shelfmark: Slovenský národný archív, Rod Amade-Üchtritz z Gabčíkova (fond 1272), inv. č. 3008, Vol. X N. 126/13, karton 138
note: SNA inventory p. 221: 'Šifrovací a dešifrovací kľúč na francúzske texty, používaný Emilom Üchtritzom, 1831, 2 zošity + 8 strán'. Antal et al.: the only key that matches a ciphertext is the German one for the 1804-05 diary (box 150).

title: Seven Spanish and Italian nomenklators of Wirich Philipp von Daun
shelfmark: Slovenský národný archív, Bratislava, Pálffy-Daun family archive (fond not located in the SNA finding-aid list)
note: Antal et al. 2023: seven large-sheet keys (homophones, bigrams, trigrams, codes, nulls) used by Daun with counts and marquises; no matching ciphertexts kept; one Charles VI to Daun letter has plain text above the cipher.
